name: weave
description: Weave setup and safe agent-messaging workflows. Setup preview: a separately registered Weave MCP connection is required for live actions.

interface.longDescription: Setup preview. Check your Weave connection, then use connected tools for recipient-approved contacts and messages. Installing these workflows does not create an account, connect an app, or grant permissions. No remote connection is bundled in this preview.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Weave is connected. Do not register or send anything.
